put.description: Switch the business's active Skill Pack. Categories, forecast seasonality and KPIs follow it.

get.description: Ledger rows, categorized by the active Skill Pack. Amounts are signed integer minor units.

post.description: Ingest a CSV statement for one account. All rows or none; re-uploading the same rows adds no duplicates.

get.description: The fact, every fact it was computed from, and the source rows they cite (owner view, with row text).
Cash-basis profit and loss per calendar month or ISO week (only days before today count).
Cash balance per account and in total, buffer days and runway.

post.description: Enroll the owner's public key (first key only; re-sending the same key is a no-op).

Execute a pending action with the owner's signature over its exact payload. Returns the gateway's decision:
`executed`, or `denied` with the rule that fired (bad signature, expired, replayed nonce, ...).
Build the payload for a T2 standing mandate. Nothing is stored; the gateway checks it when registered.
Register a signed T2 standing mandate. Its terms may lower policy caps but never raise them.

parameters.description: exact kind, or a prefix ending in '.'

get.description: The chain head: what on-chain anchoring publishes.

Recompute every hash and link (the first entry that breaks the chain is reported), then check the log against
every anchored root on chain: `onchain.ok` is false if any batch mismatches, null if nothing is anchored yet.
Download a verified copy of the log. `X-Audit-Verified` and `X-Audit-Head-*` describe the exported file.

post.description: Move the simulated clock forward, then run the overnight job for each business (unless turned off).
Ask the planner and get the whole turn at once: tool calls, gateway decisions and the checked reply.
Ask the planner and stream the turn as server-sent events. The reply arrives whole, after the firewall.

200.description: Server-sent events: conversation, tool_call, action, error, reply; then done.

get.description: The latest Morning Brief (written by the overnight job). 404 until the first one exists.

post.description: Run the overnight job now without moving the clock: reminders through the gateway, then the brief.

get.description:
Every leak finding, largest yearly impact first, with its detail facts. Open any fact with explain_fact
to see the evidence rows.
Processed messages, newest first, with sentinel flags, risk and any verification call script.

post.description: Deliver and process new mailbox messages (quarantined extractor, then the sentinel, then the forecast feed).
Process one uploaded .eml message through the same quarantine and sentinel path.

get.description: Match every product in the synthetic catalog. The lender decides; this is not a credit decision.

post.description: Export the Passport as canonical JSON. `sha256` is recorded in the audit log for anchoring.

get.description: A stored export. A file whose bytes no longer hash to its name is reported as not found.

post.description: Prepare a draft application and ask the gateway to send it. The gateway waits for the owner's signature.

get.description: The exact draft an approval refers to, so the owner reads what they sign for.
Every tier with its tools, the hard caps from policy.yaml and the standing mandates the owner has signed.
The latest `make redteam` results, as written. 404 until the suite has run.
Whether a testnet is configured, and every batch (newest first) with its root, leaves, proofs and tx.

post.description: Cut a batch now and publish its root in the background. Rate-capped by policy.yaml; testnet only.

get.description:
Recompute the mandate's hash from its stored document, find it in an anchored batch, fold its proof into a
root and compare that root with the transaction on chain.
Re-hash the exported Passport file as it is on disk now and check that hash on chain.

post.description:
For a lender or any holder of a Passport file: hash it canonically and report whether that hash is an
anchored leaf whose root is on chain. Nothing about the file is stored.

schema.title: Passport
schema.description: An exported Passport file, as JSON. It is hashed as canonical JSON.

post.description: Testing: propose an action as the planner would. Returns `executed`, `pending_approval` or `denied`.

ActionEvent.title: ActionEvent
ActionEvent.description: The gateway's decision on a proposal, straight from the gateway (not from the planner's words).

run_overnight.title: Run Overnight
run_overnight.description: Run reminders and the Morning Brief after moving

requires_out_of_band_call_script.title: Requires Out Of Band Call Script

ApprovalRequest.title: ApprovalRequest
ApprovalRequest.description: What the owner is asked to sign. `payload` is signed as canonical JSON; `args` are shown to the owner.

requires_out_of_band_call_script.title: Requires Out Of Band Call Script

ApprovalView.title: ApprovalView
ApprovalView.description: A pending (or decided) approval. The owner signs `message`: the canonical JSON bytes of `payload`.

ArgValue.title: ArgValue
ArgValue.description: One action argument with where its value came from. Provenance is required: there is no default.

CallScript.title: CallScript
CallScript.description: A verification call the owner makes on a number from their own records. Generated in code, not by an LLM.

DocumentFields.title: DocumentFields
DocumentFields.description: Everything downstream code (sentinel, forecast feed, planner tool) may use from one email and its files.

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description:
One computed value.

`value` is the machine value: integer minor units for money (with `currency` set), a float for ratios and
days, an ISO date for dates, an int for counts, or None when there is nothing to report (e.g. runway that does
not run out within the forecast horizon; `display` then says so in words).

FactTrace.title: FactTrace
FactTrace.description:
The fact, every fact it was computed from (breadth first, each once), and the rows they cite.

`rows` is capped at the requested limit, the explained fact's own rows first; `rows_total` counts them all.
`missing_inputs` lists input IDs not computed in this request (should be empty; non-empty means a bug).

FinancingResponse.title: FinancingResponse
FinancingResponse.description: Every catalog product with pass/fail and a reason per rule, the repayment-safe size, and the facts cited.

ForecastResponse.title: ForecastResponse
ForecastResponse.description: 30/60/90-day summaries and the daily expected/low/high path for the chart (about an 80% band).

Head.title: Head
Head.description: The chain head: what gets anchored. `seq` is -1 and `hash` is GENESIS_HASH for an empty log.

KpiResponse.title: KpiResponse
KpiResponse.description: The active pack's KPIs against its healthy ranges. Benchmarks are synthetic and labelled as such.

Leaf.title: Leaf
Leaf.description: One anchored hash. `ref` says where it came from (audit seq, mandate ID, Passport export), never its content.

LoanApplicationResponse.title: LoanApplicationResponse
LoanApplicationResponse.description: The draft the owner is asked to sign for, and the gateway's decision (always pending_approval or denied).

LogAnchorCheck.title: LogAnchorCheck
LogAnchorCheck.description:
The audit log against every confirmed anchor (most recent first, up to VERIFY_MAX_BATCHES).
`ok` is None when there is nothing on chain to compare with.

MandateRecord.title: MandateRecord
MandateRecord.description: A verified, stored mandate. `record_hash` is the canonical-JSON hash of `document()`, the anchoring leaf.

MorningBrief.title: MorningBrief
MorningBrief.description: What the Today screen renders. Prose carries {fact:id} placeholders resolved from `facts` (invariant 4).

OnchainCheck.title: OnchainCheck
OnchainCheck.description:
One batch checked against the chain. `match` only if the transaction is a confirmed 0-value self-transaction
on the allow-listed chain whose data equals the root recomputed here.

OwnerView.title: OwnerView
OwnerView.description: Display-only strings for the owner's screen. Never passed to the planner (invariant 2).

PassportExport.title: PassportExport
PassportExport.description: One exported Passport: `sha256` is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of `document`.

PnlPeriod.title: PnlPeriod
PnlPeriod.description:
One period. `lines` is keyed by line ID: revenue, cogs, gross_profit, gross_margin, operating_expenses,
operating_profit, revenue.<category>, expense.<category>, owner_drawings, uncategorized.count ...

ProofStep.title: ProofStep
ProofStep.description: One sibling on the path to the root. `side` is where the sibling sits: hash(left || right).

ReminderOutcome.title: ReminderOutcome
ReminderOutcome.description: One overdue invoice the overnight job looked at, and what the gateway decided.

RuleResult.title: RuleResult
RuleResult.description: One rule. `reason` is code-written text with `{fact:<id>}` placeholders and no digits outside them.

SourceRow.title: SourceRow
SourceRow.description: One cited source. Money is integer minor units; `text` is untrusted and owner-UI only.

StandingMandateDraft.title: StandingMandateDraft
StandingMandateDraft.description: A payload for the owner to sign: `args_hash` binds the terms, the nonce is fresh, `message` is what to sign.

StandingTerms.title: StandingTerms
StandingTerms.description: What a T2 standing mandate delegates: a cap (never above policy.yaml) and an allow-list of IDs.

T2Limit.title: T2Limit
T2Limit.description: A T2 tool: its policy.yaml ceiling, the owner's active standing mandate (if any) and who it could cover.
